# ForestBoar

`creature`

A stout, bristle-furred boar that roots through the forest floor for tubers and fungi. Normally passive, but fiercely territorial when its young are nearby. The most hunted creature in the temperate forest — a reliable early-game meat and hide source.

> Provide new players a safe, rewarding hunt that teaches basic combat loops

| State | Description |
| ----- | ----------- |
| `idle` | Creature is at rest; not pursuing any target |
| `alert` | Creature has detected a threat; preparing to fight or flee |
| `aggressive` | Creature is actively attacking a target |
| `fleeing` | Creature is retreating from danger; cannot attack |
| `dead` | Creature has been killed; drops are available |
| `respawning` | Creature is regenerating at its spawn point; not yet interactable |

## Actions

### detect

Detect a threat and transition from idle to alert

**Conditions:**
- Detects players within 8 tile radius
- Fires attack trigger directly from idle (no alert phase) if player is within 3 tiles of boarlet (juvenile)

### attack

Charge the target with a tusk gore

**Conditions:**
- Gore deals baseDamage; knocks back target 1 tile
- Charge requires 2-tile run-up; no knockback at close range

### flee

Retreat when health drops below 25%

**Conditions:**
- Flees toward dense undergrowth; loses aggro if player breaks line of sight for 10 seconds

### die

Transition to dead state; trigger loot drop and start respawn timer

**Conditions:**
- Emits a death event consumed by the drop behavior; respawn timer begins immediately

### drop

Drop loot on death

**Conditions:**
- Always drops: raw boar meat (1–3), boar hide (1)
- Chance drop: boar tusk (20%)

### respawn

Regenerate at the biome spawn point after a cooldown

**Conditions:**
- Respawn cooldown: 5 in-game minutes; respawn point is the nearest ForestBoar spawn marker

### calm

Return to idle when threat is no longer detected

**Conditions:**
- Alert-to-idle: 30 seconds without threat; fleeing-to-idle: reaches safe zone
